# Season 6 trips analysis - look at when peak happened (d174-d189)
trips_s6 = tables['trips'][tables['trips']['fished_date_season'] == 6].copy()

# Group by fished_date_doy and class to calculate avg yt/angler
trips_summary = trips_s6.groupby(['fished_date_doy', 'cls']).agg({
    'yt': 'sum',
    'anglers': 'sum',
}).reset_index()

trips_summary['yt_per_angler'] = trips_summary['yt'] / trips_summary['anglers']
trips_summary = trips_summary.sort_values('fished_date_doy')

# Focus on key windows: spring (d100-d150), summer lull (d150-d170), Oct peak (d170-d213)
print("=== SPRING WINDOW (D100-D150) ===")
spring = trips_summary[(trips_summary['fished_date_doy'] >= 100) & (trips_summary['fished_date_doy'] <= 150)]
print(spring.groupby('fished_date_doy')['yt_per_angler'].max().to_string())

print("\n=== SUMMER LULL (D150-D170) ===")
summer = trips_summary[(trips_summary['fished_date_doy'] >= 150) & (trips_summary['fished_date_doy'] < 170)]
print(summer.groupby('fished_date_doy')['yt_per_angler'].max().to_string())

print("\n=== OCTOBER PEAK (D170-D210) - WHEN I WAS BROKE ===")
peak = trips_summary[(trips_summary['fished_date_doy'] >= 170) & (trips_summary['fished_date_doy'] <= 210)]
print(peak.pivot_table(index='fished_date_doy', columns='cls', values='yt_per_angler', aggfunc='first').to_string())

# Count sustained >1.5 yt/angler runs
print("\n=== MULTI-DAY WINDOWS >1.5 YT/ANGLER ===")
three_q = trips_summary[trips_summary['cls'] == 'three_quarter'].copy()
print("THREE_QUARTER class peaks:")
print(three_q[three_q['yt_per_angler'] >= 1.5][['fished_date_doy', 'yt_per_angler']].to_string())

# Water temperature analysis from Scripps Pier
pier_s6 = tables['pier'][tables['pier']['ts_season'] == 6].copy()

# Get daily max/mean water temps
pier_daily = pier_s6.groupby('ts_doy').agg({
    'wtmp_c': ['min', 'mean', 'max', 'count']
}).reset_index()
pier_daily.columns = ['doy', 'wtmp_min_c', 'wtmp_mean_c', 'wtmp_max_c', 'count']

# Convert to Fahrenheit
for col in ['wtmp_min_c', 'wtmp_mean_c', 'wtmp_max_c']:
    pier_daily[col] = pier_daily[col] * 9/5 + 32

# 7-day rolling mean
pier_daily = pier_daily.sort_values('doy').reset_index(drop=True)
pier_daily['wtmp_7day_mean_f'] = pier_daily['wtmp_mean_c'].rolling(7, center=False).mean()

# Key windows
print("=== SPRING (D100-D150) ===")
spring_water = pier_daily[(pier_daily['doy'] >= 100) & (pier_daily['doy'] <= 150)]
print(spring_water[['doy', 'wtmp_mean_c', 'wtmp_7day_mean_f']].to_string())

print("\n\n=== SUMMER LULL (D150-D170) ===")
summer_water = pier_daily[(pier_daily['doy'] >= 150) & (pier_daily['doy'] < 170)]
print(summer_water[['doy', 'wtmp_mean_c', 'wtmp_7day_mean_f']].tail(20).to_string())

print("\n\n=== OCTOBER PEAK (D170-D210) ===")
peak_water = pier_daily[(pier_daily['doy'] >= 170) & (pier_daily['doy'] <= 210)]
print(peak_water[['doy', 'wtmp_mean_c', 'wtmp_7day_mean_f']].to_string())

# Find where water crossed 66°F and 68°F gates
print("\n\n=== GATE CROSSINGS ===")
print("First time >66°F (sustained 7d mean): ", end="")
above_66 = pier_daily[pier_daily['wtmp_7day_mean_f'] >= 66.0]
if len(above_66) > 0:
    print(f"d{above_66.iloc[0]['doy']:.0f}")
else:
    print("Never")

print("First time >68°F (sustained 7d mean): ", end="")
above_68 = pier_daily[pier_daily['wtmp_7day_mean_f'] >= 68.0]
if len(above_68) > 0:
    print(f"d{above_68.iloc[0]['doy']:.0f}")
else:
    print("Never")
